closeout.summary: CTA Band alone was migrated behind a feature-local public boundary on baseline 17529d477ab19a0c3fbae05e514d14029e70feda. All eleven blocks are mapped; import, comment, feature-map, quick, full, and browser gates passed. Reviews at 72569a835b3bb907c993eb80642a25290a82caf2 and ff0629c0eb637e393c04ee2e3f57fbbc4a8f101d each found a required_fix, both were repaired and reverified, and the final immutable implementation 0df43df8db053f5840d21d57ac491edab6eda39f was clean on repository-standards and confirmed-source-intent axes. No product/runtime change is included in closeout bookkeeping.
